Every rank stores only\n//   its own rows, in a SIMD friendly \"row tile\" layout: groups of MR consecutive\n//   local rows are stored k-major (tile[k][0..MR)), so that for a fixed column k\n//   the MR row entries are contiguous.\n// * The factorization is a blocked left-looking algorithm over column panels of\n//   NB columns (NB is a multiple of RB, so a panel consists of several row\n//   blocks that may live on different ranks).  // vectorization factor of the original's reduction loops\n#else\nconstexpr size_t VF = 2;\n#endif\n\ntypedef double vd __attribute__((vector_size(VL * sizeof(double))));\n\ninline vd vload(const double* p) {\n    vd v;\n    memcpy(&v, p, sizeof(v));\n    return v;\n}\ninline void vstore(double* p, vd v) { memcpy(p, &v, sizeof(v)); }\ninline vd vsplat(double x) {\n    vd v;\n    for (int i = 0; i < VL; ++i) v[i] = x;\n    return v;\n}\n\n// Fused multiply-add on vectors (explicit; the file is compiled with -ffp-contract=off)\ninline vd vfma(vd a, vd b, vd c) {\n    vd r;\n    for (int i = 0; i < VL; ++i) r[i] = __builtin_fma(a[i], b[i], c[i]);\n    return r;\n}\n\nconstexpr size_t gcd_(size_t a, size_t b) { return b == 0 ? a : gcd_(b, a % b); }\nconstexpr size_t lcm_(size_t a, size_t b) { return a / gcd_(a, b) * b; }\nconstexpr size_t RB = lcm_(lcm_(MR, NR), VF);  // row distribution block (24 for AVX2)\nconstexpr size_t GPB = RB / NR;                 // column groups per row block\n\n// C[j][0..MR) (+)= sum_{k0 <= k < k0+klen} round(A[k][0..MR) * B[k][j])\n//   (k in increasing order; X[j][:]  (sum over k in increasing order)\n// a_tiles : my rows of X in tile layout, my_cols : my rows of X column-major.\n// store(t, j, s) receives the MR values for tile t, column j.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ntemplate <class Store>\nvoid symmetricProductRing(const Layout& L, const std::vector<double>& a_tiles,\n                          std::vector<double> my_cols, Store&& store) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    const int P = L.P, rank = L.rank;\n    constexpr size_t CB = 4 * RB;  // columns per chunk\n    size_t maxpad = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) maxpad = std::max(maxpad, L.mpad_of(r));\n\n    std::vector<double> cur = std::move(my_cols);\n    cur.resize(n * maxpad + 2 * VL);\n    std::vector<double> nxt(n * maxpad + 2 * VL);\n    std::vector<double> Bp(n * CB);\n    std::vector<double> S(L.m_tiles * CB * MR);\n    const double* groups[CB / NR];\n    for (size_t g = 0; g < CB / NR; ++g) groups[g] = Bp.data() + g * n * NR;\n\n    const int right = (rank + 1) % P;\n    const int left = (rank - 1 + P) % P;\n\n    for (int s = 0; s < P; ++s) {\n        const int src = (rank - s + P) % P;\n        const size_t src_pad = L.mpad_of(src);\n        const size_t src_loc = L.mloc_of(src);\n        MPI_Request reqs[2] = {MPI_REQUEST_NULL, MPI_REQUEST_NULL};\n        if (s + 1 < P) {\n            const int nsrc = (rank - s - 1 + P) % P;\n            MPI_Irecv(nxt.data(), (int)(n * L.mpad_of(nsrc)), MPI_DOUBLE, left, 100 + s,\n                      MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[0]);\n            MPI_Isend(cur.data(), (int)(n * src_pad), MPI_DOUBLE, right, 100 + s, MPI_COMM_WORLD,\n                      &reqs[1]);\n        }\n        const size_t kmain = n - n % VF;  // non-fused part\n        for (size_t c0 = 0; c0 < src_pad; c0 += CB) {\n            const size_t ncols = std::min(CB, src_pad - c0);\n            const size_t ncols_valid = c0 < src_loc ? std::min(ncols, src_loc - c0) : 0;\n            if (ncols_valid == 0) continue;\n            pack_groups(cur.data() + c0, src_pad, ncols, n, Bp.data());\n            for (size_t k0 = 0; k0 < kmain; k0 += KC) {\n                const size_t klen = std::min<size_t>(KC, kmain - k0);\n                for (size_t t = 0; t < L.m_tiles; ++t)\n                    kernel(a_tiles.data() + t * L.tile_stride() + k0 * MR, MR, groups, k0, ncols,\n                           klen, S.data() + t * CB * MR, MR, k0 > 0);\n            }\n            if (kmain == 0) std::fill(S.begin(), S.end(), 0.0);\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < L.m_tiles; ++t) {\n                const double* tp = a_tiles.data() + t * L.tile_stride();\n                for (size_t jj = 0; jj < ncols_valid; ++jj) {\n                    double* Sj = S.data() + t * CB * MR + jj * MR;\n                    for (size_t k = kmain; k < n; ++k) {  // fused remainder\n                        const vd bv = vsplat(cur[k * src_pad + c0 + jj]);\n                        for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v)\n                            vstore(Sj + v * VL, vfma(vload(tp + k * MR + v * VL), bv, vload(Sj + v * VL)));\n                    }\n                    const size_t jloc = c0 + jj;\n                    const size_t jglob = ((size_t)src + (jloc / RB) * P) * RB + jloc % RB;\n                    store(t, jglob, Sj);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if (s + 1 < P) {\n            MPI_Waitall(2, reqs, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n            std::swap(cur, nxt);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Matrix generation: A = B * B^T + n * I, B random (same sequence as original)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const Layout& L) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    std::vector<double> Bt(L.m_tiles * L.tile_stride(), 0.0);\n    std::vector<double> Bcols(n * L.m_pad, 0.0);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (every rank walks the full sequence, keeps its rows)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const size_t gb = i / RB;\n        if (L.owner(gb) == L.rank) {\n            const size_t iloc = (gb / L.P) * RB + i % RB;\n            double* tp = Bt.data() + (iloc / MR) * L.tile_stride() + iloc % MR;\n            double* cp = Bcols.data() + iloc;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                const double v = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n                tp[k * MR] = v;\n                cp[k * L.m_pad] = v;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) (void)rand_r(&seed);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T and add diagonal dominance\n    A.assign(L.m_tiles * L.tile_stride(), 0.0);\n    const double nd = (double)n;\n    symmetricProductRing(L, Bt, std::move(Bcols), [&](size_t t, size_t j, const double* s) {\n        double* dst = A.data() + t * L.tile_stride() + j * MR;\n        for (int l = 0; l < MR; ++l) {\n            const size_t iloc = t * MR + l;\n            if (iloc >= L.m_loc) continue;\n            double v = s[l];\n            if (L.global_row(iloc) == j) v += nd;\n            dst[l] = v;\n        }\n    });\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Validation: compare L * L^T with the original matrix\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& Lt, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,\n                      const Layout& L) {\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    symmetricProductRing(L, Lt, tilesToColumns(Lt, L), [&](size_t t, size_t j, const double* s) {\n        const double* ref = A_orig.data() + t * L.tile_stride() + j * MR;\n        for (int l = 0; l < MR; ++l) {\n            if (t * MR + l >= L.m_loc) continue;\n            const double error = fabs(s[l] - ref[l]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(ref[l]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    });\n    double g[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, g, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    maxError = g[0];\n    relError = g[1];\n\n    if (L.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (L.rank == 0) printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed blocked left-looking Cholesky decomposition\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& T, const Layout& L) {\n    const size_t n = L.n, nb = L.nb, nsb = L.nsb, npanels = L.npanels, n_pad = L.n_pad;\n    const int P = L.P, rank = L.rank;\n    const size_t ts = L.tile_stride();\n    const size_t ngroups = nb / NR;\n    const size_t tiles_per_block = RB / MR;\n    const size_t SD_LD = nb + MR;  // row stride of the diagonal partial sums (+ junk columns)\n\n    // Panel buffers (double buffered): panel J holds, for every column j of the\n    // panel, L[j][k] for k < j0 and the stored A values for k in [j0, j0+nb),\n    // packed in column groups of NR; rows of the panel are gathered rank-major.\n    std::vector<double> Pbuf[2] = {std::vector<double>(nb * n_pad + 2 * VL, 0.0),\n                                   std::vector<double>(nb * n_pad + 2 * VL, 0.0)};\n    std::vector<double> zeros(n_pad * NR + 2 * VL, 0.0);  // stands in for missing row blocks\n    std::vector<const double*> groups(ngroups);\n    std::vector<double> S(L.m_tiles * nb * MR);  // partial sums of my trailing rows, per tile\n    std::vector<double> Sd(nb * SD_LD, 0.0);     // partial sums of the diagonal block\n    std::vector<double> Dt(nb * nb, 0.0);        // diagonal block, Dt[kk][ii] = L[ii][kk]\n    std::vector<int> pcounts(P), pdispls(P), scounts(P), sdispls(P);\n\n    // Diagonal block work split: column groups of the panel\n    auto share_begin = [&](int r) { return ((size_t)r * ngroups / P) * NR; };\n    for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n        sdispls[r] = (int)(share_begin(r) * SD_LD);\n        scounts[r] = (int)((share_begin(r + 1) - share_begin(r)) * SD_LD);\n    }\n    const size_t js = share_begin(rank), je = share_begin(rank + 1);\n\n    // Allgather layout of panel J: rank r contributes its row blocks of the panel\n    auto panel_layout = [&](size_t J, size_t& bts) {\n        bts = (J + 1) * nb * NR;  // group stride (krows * NR)\n        const size_t gb0 = J * nsb;\n        const size_t nsb_cur = std::min(nsb, L.nblocks - gb0);\n        int off = 0;\n        for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n            int cnt = 0;\n            for (size_t s = 0; s < nsb_cur; ++s)\n                if (L.owner(gb0 + s) == r) ++cnt;\n            pdispls[r] = off;\n            pcounts[r] = (int)(cnt * GPB * bts);\n            off += pcounts[r];\n        }\n    };\n    auto panel_groups = [&](size_t J, const double* buf, size_t bts) {\n        const size_t gb0 = J * nsb;\n        const size_t nsb_cur = std::min(nsb, L.nblocks - gb0);\n        std::vector<int> idx(P, 0);\n        for (size_t g = 0; g < ngroups; ++g) groups[g] = zeros.data();\n        for (size_t s = 0; s < nsb_cur; ++s) {\n            const int r = L.owner(gb0 + s);\n            for (size_t g = 0; g < GPB; ++g)\n                groups[s * GPB + g] = buf + pdispls[r] + ((size_t)idx[r] * GPB + g) * bts;\n            ++idx[r];\n        }\n    };\n    // Pack my row blocks of panel J (rows k < (J+1)*nb) into my part of buf\n    auto pack_panel = [&](size_t J, double* buf, size_t bts) {\n        const size_t gb0 = J * nsb;\n        const size_t nsb_cur = std::min(nsb, L.nblocks - gb0);\n        const size_t krows = (J + 1) * nb;\n        const size_t kend = std::min(n, krows);\n        double* dst = buf + pdispls[rank];\n        for (size_t s = 0; s < nsb_cur; ++s) {\n            if (L.owner(gb0 + s) != rank) continue;\n            const size_t t0 = ((gb0 + s) / P) * tiles_per_block;\n            for (size_t g = 0; g < GPB; ++g, dst += bts) {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < kend; ++k) {\n                    for (int j = 0; j < NR; ++j) {\n                        const size_t jj = g * NR + j;\n                        dst[k * NR + j] = T[(t0 + jj / MR) * ts + k * MR + jj % MR];\n                    }\n                }\n                std::fill(dst + kend * NR, dst + krows * NR, 0.0);\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    MPI_Request req_panel = MPI_REQUEST_NULL, req_sd = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n    auto progress = [&]() {\n        int flag;\n        if (req_sd != MPI_REQUEST_NULL) MPI_Test(&req_sd, &flag, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        if (req_panel != MPI_REQUEST_NULL) MPI_Test(&req_panel, &flag, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n    };\n\n    // Partial sums over k < j0 for trailing tiles [ta, tb)\n    auto gemm = [&](size_t ta, size_t tb, size_t j0) {\n        for (size_t k0 = 0; k0 < j0; k0 += KC) {\n            const size_t klen = std::min<size_t>(KC, j0 - k0);\n            for (size_t t = ta; t < tb; ++t) {\n                kernel(T.data() + t * ts + k0 * MR, MR, groups.data(), k0, nb, klen, S.data() + t * nb * MR,\n                       MR, k0 > 0);\n                progress();\n            }\n        }\n        if (j0 == 0) std::fill(S.begin() + ta * nb * MR, S.begin() + tb * nb * MR, 0.0);\n    };\n    // Triangular tail of the panel and final division for trailing tiles [ta, tb)\n    auto tail = [&](size_t ta, size_t tb, size_t j0, size_t nb_cur) {\n        for (size_t t = ta; t < tb; ++t) {\n            double* tp = T.data() + t * ts;\n            const double* St = S.data() + t * nb * MR;\n            for (size_t jj = 0; jj < nb_cur; ++jj) {\n                vd s[MV];\n                for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) s[v] = vload(St + jj * MR + v * VL);\n                const size_t kmain = jj - jj % VF;\n                for (size_t kk = 0; kk < kmain; ++kk) {\n                    const vd ljk = vsplat(Dt[kk * nb + jj]);\n                    const double* ap = tp + (j0 + kk) * MR;\n                    for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) s[v] += vload(ap + v * VL) * ljk;\n                }\n                for (size_t kk = kmain; kk < jj; ++kk) {  // fused remainder\n                    const vd ljk = vsplat(Dt[kk * nb + jj]);\n                    const double* ap = tp + (j0 + kk) * MR;\n                    for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) s[v] = vfma(vload(ap + v * VL), ljk, s[v]);\n                }\n                const vd ljj = vsplat(Dt[jj * nb + jj]);\n                double* ap = tp + (j0 + jj) * MR;\n                for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) vstore(ap + v * VL, (vload(ap + v * VL) - s[v]) / ljj);\n            }\n            progress();\n        }\n    };\n\n    int cur = 0;\n    size_t bts_cur = 0;\n    if (npanels > 0) {\n        panel_layout(0, bts_cur);\n        pack_panel(0, Pbuf[0].data(), bts_cur);\n        MPI_Iallgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, Pbuf[0].data(), pcounts.data(), pdispls.data(),\n                        MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req_panel);\n    }\n\n    for (size_t J = 0; J < npanels; ++J) {\n        const size_t j0 = J * nb;\n        const size_t nb_cur = std::min(nb, n - j0);\n        const double* Pj = Pbuf[cur].data();\n\n        MPI_Wait(&req_panel, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        panel_groups(J, Pj, bts_cur);\n\n        // Partial sums of the diagonal block, computed cooperatively (my column groups)\n        if (j0 > 0) {\n            for (size_t gi = 0; gi < ngroups && js < je; ++gi)\n                kernel(groups[gi], NR, groups.data() + js / NR, 0, je - js, j0, Sd.data() + js * SD_LD + gi * NR,\n                       SD_LD, false);\n            MPI_Iallgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, Sd.data(), scounts.data(), sdispls.data(),\n                            MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req_sd);\n        } else {\n            std::fill(Sd.begin(), Sd.end(), 0.0);\n        }\n\n        // Trailing rows: tiles [t_first, m_tiles)\n        const size_t t_first = L.nblk_before((J + 1) * nsb) * tiles_per_block;\n        gemm(t_first, L.m_tiles, j0);\n\n        // Diagonal block: A values from the panel, then factor it (redundantly on\n        // every rank, identical arithmetic)\n        MPI_Wait(&req_sd, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < nb; ++kk)\n            for (size_t ii = 0; ii < nb; ++ii) Dt[kk * nb + ii] = groups[ii / NR][(j0 + kk) * NR + ii % NR];\n        for (size_t jj = 0; jj < nb_cur; ++jj) {\n            double* Sj = Sd.data() + jj * SD_LD;\n            const size_t kmain = jj - jj % VF;\n            for (size_t kk = 0; kk < kmain; ++kk) {\n                const double* Lk = Dt.data() + kk * nb;  // Lk[ii] = L[ii][kk]\n                const double ljk = Lk[jj];\n                for (size_t ii = jj; ii < nb_cur; ++ii) Sj[ii] += Lk[ii] * ljk;\n            }\n            for (size_t kk = kmain; kk < jj; ++kk) {  // fused remainder\n                const double* Lk = Dt.data() + kk * nb;\n                const double ljk = Lk[jj];\n                for (size_t ii = jj; ii < nb_cur; ++ii) Sj[ii] = __builtin_fma(Lk[ii], ljk, Sj[ii]);\n            }\n            double* Aj = Dt.data() + jj * nb;  // Aj[ii] = A[ii][jj] -> L[ii][jj]\n            const double val = Aj[jj] - Sj[jj];\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Matrix is not positive definite\n                if (rank == 0) printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j0 + jj);\n                return false;\n            }\n            const double ljj = sqrt(val);\n            Aj[jj] = ljj;\n            for (size_t ii = jj + 1; ii < nb_cur; ++ii) Aj[ii] = (Aj[ii] - Sj[ii]) / ljj;\n            for (size_t ii = 0; ii < jj; ++ii) Aj[ii] = 0.0;  // upper part\n        }\n\n        // Owners store the factored diagonal block rows\n        {\n            const size_t gb0 = J * nsb;\n            const size_t nsb_cur = std::min(nsb, L.nblocks - gb0);\n            for (size_t s = 0; s < nsb_cur; ++s) {\n                if (L.owner(gb0 + s) != rank) continue;\n                const size_t t0 = ((gb0 + s) / P) * tiles_per_block;\n                for (size_t kk = 0; kk < nb_cur; ++kk) {\n                    const double* row = Dt.data() + kk * nb + s * RB;\n                    for (size_t tt = 0; tt < tiles_per_block; ++tt)\n                        memcpy(T.data() + (t0 + tt) * ts + (j0 + kk) * MR, row + tt * MR, MR * sizeof(double));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Finish the rows of the next panel first and start gathering them\n        // (look-ahead), then the remaining trailing rows.\n        const bool has_next = J + 1 < npanels;\n        size_t t_split = t_first;\n        if (has_next) {\n            const size_t t_next_end = L.nblk_before((J + 2) * nsb) * tiles_per_block;\n            tail(t_first, t_next_end, j0, nb_cur);\n            t_split = t_next_end;\n            size_t bts_next;\n            panel_layout(J + 1, bts_next);\n            pack_panel(J + 1, Pbuf[cur ^ 1].data(), bts_next);\n            MPI_Iallgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, Pbuf[cur ^ 1].data(), pcounts.data(),\n                            pdispls.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req_panel);\n            bts_cur = bts_next;\n        }\n        tail(t_split, L.m_tiles, j0, nb_cur);\n        cur ^= 1;\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part (and padding rows)\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < L.m_tiles; ++t) {\n        double* tp = T.data() + t * ts;\n        for (int l = 0; l < MR; ++l) {\n            const size_t iloc = t * MR + l;\n            const size_t kstart = (iloc < L.m_loc) ? L.global_row(iloc) + 1 : 0;\n            for (size_t k = kstart; k < n; ++k) tp[k * MR + l] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather the full matrix (row-major) on rank 0.\nvoid gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& T, const Layout& L, std::vector<double>& A) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    std::vector<double> rows(L.m_loc * n);\n    for (size_t iloc = 0; iloc < L.m_loc; ++iloc)\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) rows[iloc * n + k] = tileAt(T, L, iloc, k);\n\n    if (L.rank == 0) {\n        A.assign(n * n, 0.0);\n        std::vector<double> tmp;\n        for (int r = 0; r < L.P; ++r) {\n            const double* src = rows.data();\n            if (r != 0) {\n                tmp.resize(L.mloc_of(r) * n);\n                MPI_Recv(tmp.data(), (int)tmp.size(), MPI_DOUBLE, r, 7, MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n                src = tmp.data();\n            }\n            for (size_t lb = 0; lb < L.nblk_of(r); ++lb) {\n                const size_t gb = (size_t)r + lb * L.P;\n                const size_t nrows = std::min(RB, n - gb * RB);\n                memcpy(A.data() + gb * RB * n, src + lb * RB * n, nrows * n * sizeof(double));\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        MPI_Send(rows.data(), (int)rows.size(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, 7, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n}  // namespace\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int P = 1, rank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &P);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", P);\n    }\n\n    const Layout L = makeLayout(n, P, rank);\n\n    // Allocate (distributed) matrix\n    std::vector<double> A;\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    if (rank == 0) printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, L);\n\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A;  // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (rank == 0) printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, L);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double end = MPI_Wtime();\n    const long duration_ms = (long)((end - start) * 1000.0);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (rank == 0) printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration_ms);\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n        double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n        double gflops = ops / (duration_ms / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<double> full;\n        gatherMatrix(A, L, full);\n        if (rank == 0) print_results(full, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    int ret = 0;\n    if (validate) {\n        if (rank == 0) printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool jt < ncols; jt += NR) {\n        __m256d acc[NR][MV];\n        for (int j = 0; j < NR; ++j)\n            for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v)\n                acc[j][v] = accumulate ? _mm256_loadu_pd(c + (jt + j) * cs + v * VL) : _mm256_setzero_pd();\n        const double* bp = groups[jt / NR] + k0 * NR;\n        const double* ap = a;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k0 < kmain; k0 += KC) {\n                const size_t klen = std::min<size_t>(KC, kmain - k0);\n                for (size_t t = 0; t < L.m_tiles; ++t)\n                    kernel(a_tiles.data() + t * L.tile_stride() + k0 * MR, MR, groups, k0, ncols,\n                           klen, S.data() + t * CB * MR, MR, k0 > 0);\n            }\n            if (kmain == 0) std::fill(S.begin(), S.end(), 0.0);\n            for (size_t t = 0; k < n; ++k) (void)rand_r(&seed);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T and add diagonal dominance\n    A.assign(L.m_tiles * L.tile_stride(), 0.0);\n    const double nd = (double)n;\n    symmetricProductRing(L, Bt, std::move(Bcols), [&](size_t t, size_t j, const double* s) {\n        double* dst = A.data() + t * L.tile_stride() + j * MR;\n        for (int l = 0;        // vector registers per row tile\nconstexpr int MR = MV * VL;  // rows per row tile\nconstexpr int KC = 256;      // k blocking (A tile chunk stays in L1)\n#if defined(__AVX__)\nconstexpr size_t VF = 4;  // vectorization factor of the original's reduction loops\n#else\nconstexpr size_t VF = 2;\n#endif\n\ntypedef double vd __attribute__((vector_size(VL * sizeof(double))));\n\ninline vd vload(const double* p) {\n    vd v;\n    memcpy(&v, p, sizeof(v));\n    return v;\n}\ninline void vstore(double* p, vd v) { memcpy(p, &v, sizeof(v)); }\ninline vd vsplat(double x) {\n    vd v;\n    for (int i = 0; i < VL; ++i) v[i] = x;\n    return v;\n}\n\n// Fused multiply-add on vectors (explicit; the file is compiled with -ffp-contract=off)\ninline vd vfma(vd a, vd b, vd c) {\n    vd r;\n    for (int i = 0; i < VL; ++i) r[i] = __builtin_fma(a[i], b[i], c[i]);\n    return r;\n}\n\nconstexpr size_t gcd_(size_t a, size_t b) { return b == 0 ? a : gcd_(b, a % b); }\nconstexpr size_t lcm_(size_t a, size_t b) { return a / gcd_(a, b) * b; }\nconstexpr size_t RB = lcm_(lcm_(MR, NR), VF);  // row distribution block (24 for AVX2)\nconstexpr size_t GPB = RB / NR;                 // column groups per row block\n\n// C[j][0..MR) (+)= sum_{k0 <= k < k0+klen} round(A[k][0..MR) * B[k][j])\n//   (k in increasing order; product rounded, then added)\n//   a      : row tile, element (k, r) at a[k*as + r]   (k relative to k0)\n//   groups : groups[g] points to a packed column group, element (k, j) at\n//            groups[g][k*NR + j] for column j of group g (absolute k)\n//   c      : element (j, r) at c[j*cs + r]; accumulated into if accumulate\n// ncols must be a multiple of NR.\nvoid kernel(const double* __restrict a, size_t as, const double* const* groups, size_t k0,\n            size_t ncols, size_t klen, double* __restrict c, size_t cs, bool accumulate) {\n#if defined(__AVX2__)\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < ncols; jt += NR) {\n        __m256d acc[NR][MV];\n        for (int j = 0; j < NR; ++j)\n            for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v)\n                acc[j][v] = accumulate ? _mm256_loadu_pd(c + (jt + j) * cs + v * VL) : _mm256_setzero_pd();\n        const double* bp = groups[jt / NR] + k0 * NR;\n        const double* ap = a;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < klen; ++k, ap += as, bp += NR) {\n            __m256d av[MV];\n            for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) av[v] = _mm256_loadu_pd(ap + v * VL);\n            for (int j = 0; j < NR; ++j) {\n                const __m256d bv = _mm256_broadcast_sd(bp + j);\n                for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) acc[j][v] = _mm256_add_pd(acc[j][v], _mm256_mul_pd(av[v], bv));\n            }\n        }\n        for (int j = 0; j < NR; ++j)\n            for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) _mm256_storeu_pd(c + (jt + j) * cs + v * VL, acc[j][v]);\n    }\n#else\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < ncols; jt += NR) {\n        vd acc[NR][MV];\n        for (int j = 0; j < NR; ++j)\n            for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) acc[j][v] = accumulate ? vload(c + (jt + j) * cs + v * VL) : vsplat(0.0);\n        const double* bp = groups[jt / NR] + k0 * NR;\n        const double* ap = a;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < klen; ++k, ap += as, bp += NR) {\n            vd av[MV];\n            for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) {\n                av[v] = vload(ap + v * VL);\n                __asm__(\"\" : \"+x\"(av[v]));  // keep in a register (avoid re-loading per column)\n            }\n            for (int j = 0; j < NR; ++j) {\n                const vd bv = vsplat(bp[j]);\n                for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) acc[j][v] += av[v] * bv;\n            }\n        }\n        for (int j = 0; j < NR; ++j)\n            for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) vstore(c + (jt + j) * cs + v * VL, acc[j][v]);\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\n// Pack a (K x ncols) row-major panel (row stride ss) into consecutive column\n// groups of NR columns: dst[g*K*NR + k*NR + j] = src[k*ss + g*NR + j].\nvoid pack_groups(const double* src, size_t ss, size_t ncols, size_t K, double* dst) {\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < K; ++k) {\n        const double* s = src + k * ss;\n        for (size_t g = 0; g < ncols / NR; ++g) {\n            double* d = dst + g * K * NR + k * NR;\n            for (int j = 0; j < NR; ++j) d[j] = s[g * NR + j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Data distribution\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct Layout {\n    int P = 1, rank = 0;\n    size_t n = 0;        // matrix size\n    size_t nb = 0;       // panel width (multiple of RB)\n    size_t nsb = 0;      // row blocks per panel (nb / RB)\n    size_t nblocks = 0;  // number of row blocks (of RB rows)\n    size_t npanels = 0;  // number of column panels\n    size_t n_pad = 0;    // npanels * nb\n    size_t m_blk = 0;    // my number of row blocks\n    size_t m_loc = 0;    // my number of (real) rows\n    size_t m_pad = 0;    // m_blk * RB (padded rows)\n    size_t m_tiles = 0;  // m_pad / MR\n\n    int owner(size_t gb) const { return (int)(gb % (size_t)P); }\n    size_t nblk_of(int r) const { return nblocks > (size_t)r ? (nblocks - r + P - 1) / P : 0; }\n    size_t mpad_of(int r) const { return nblk_of(r) * RB; }\n    size_t mloc_of(int r) const {\n        const size_t nbr = nblk_of(r);\n        if (nbr == 0) return 0;\n        const size_t last = (size_t)r + (nbr - 1) * P;\n        return (nbr - 1) * RB + std::min(RB, n - last * RB);\n    }\n    // number of my row blocks with global block index < gb_end\n    size_t nblk_before(size_t gb_end) const {\n        gb_end = std::min(gb_end, nblocks);\n        return gb_end > (size_t)rank ? (gb_end - rank + P - 1) / P : 0;\n    }\n    // global row index of a local row (may be >= n for padding rows)\n    size_t global_row(size_t iloc) const { return ((size_t)rank + (iloc / RB) * P) * RB + iloc % RB; }\n    size_t tile_stride() const { return n * MR; }\n};\n\nLayout makeLayout(size_t n, int P, int rank) {\n    Layout L;\n    L.P = P;\n    L.rank = rank;\n    L.n = n;\n    size_t nb = 4 * RB;  // 96 columns per panel\n    // Use a narrower panel for small matrices (fewer idle ranks in the last steps).\n    while (nb > RB && (n + nb - 1) / nb < 4) nb -= RB;\n    L.nb = nb;\n    L.nsb = nb / RB;\n    L.nblocks = (n + RB - 1) / RB;\n    L.npanels = (n + nb - 1) / nb;\n    L.n_pad = L.npanels * nb;\n    L.m_blk = L.nblk_of(rank);\n    L.m_loc = L.mloc_of(rank);\n    L.m_pad = L.m_blk * RB;\n    L.m_tiles = L.m_pad / MR;\n    return L;\n}\n\n// Element (iloc, k) in the row-tile layout.\ninline double tileAt(const std::vector<double>& T, const Layout& L, size_t iloc, size_t k) {\n    return T[(iloc / MR) * L.tile_stride() + k * MR + iloc % MR];\n}\n\n// Column-major copy of my rows: element (k, iloc) at out[k*m_pad + iloc].\nstd::vector<double> tilesToColumns(const std::vector<double>& T, const Layout& L) {\n    std::vector<double> cols(L.n * L.m_pad, 0.0);\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < L.m_tiles; ++t) {\n        const double* tp = T.data() + t * L.tile_stride();\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < L.n; ++k)\n            memcpy(cols.data() + k * L.m_pad + t * MR, tp + k * MR, MR * sizeof(double));\n    }\n    return cols;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed symmetric product: for my rows i and all columns j compute\n//   X[i][:] . X[j][:]  (sum over k in increasing order)\n// a_tiles : my rows of X in tile layout, my_cols : my rows of X column-major.\n// store(t, j, s) receives the MR values for tile t, column j.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ntemplate <class Store>\nvoid symmetricProductRing(const Layout& L, const std::vector<double>& a_tiles,\n                          std::vector<double> my_cols, Store&& store) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    const int P = L.P, rank = L.rank;\n    constexpr size_t CB = 4 * RB;  // columns per chunk\n    size_t maxpad = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) maxpad = std::max(maxpad, L.mpad_of(r));\n\n    std::vector<double> cur = std::move(my_cols);\n    cur.resize(n * maxpad + 2 * VL);\n    std::vector<double> nxt(n * maxpad + 2 * VL);\n    std::vector<double> Bp(n * CB + 2 * VL);\n    std::vector<double> S(L.m_tiles * CB * MR);\n    const double* groups[CB / NR];\n    for (size_t g = 0; g < CB / NR; ++g) groups[g] = Bp.data() + g * n * NR;\n\n    const int right = (rank + 1) % P;\n    const int left = (rank - 1 + P) % P;\n\n    for (int s = 0; s < P; ++s) {\n        const int src = (rank - s + P) % P;\n        const size_t src_pad = L.mpad_of(src);\n        const size_t src_loc = L.mloc_of(src);\n        MPI_Request reqs[2] = {MPI_REQUEST_NULL, MPI_REQUEST_NULL};\n        if (s + 1 < P) {\n            const int nsrc = (rank - s - 1 + P) % P;\n            MPI_Irecv(nxt.data(), (int)(n * L.mpad_of(nsrc)), MPI_DOUBLE, left, 100 + s,\n                      MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[0]);\n            MPI_Isend(cur.data(), (int)(n * src_pad), MPI_DOUBLE, right, 100 + s, MPI_COMM_WORLD,\n                      &reqs[1]);\n        }\n        const size_t kmain = n - n % VF;  // non-fused part\n        for (size_t c0 = 0; c0 < src_pad; c0 += CB) {\n            const size_t ncols = std::min(CB, src_pad - c0);\n            const size_t ncols_valid = c0 < src_loc ? std::min(ncols, src_loc - c0) : 0;\n            if (ncols_valid == 0) continue;\n            pack_groups(cur.data() + c0, src_pad, ncols, n, Bp.data());\n            for (size_t k0 = 0; k0 < kmain; k0 += KC) {\n                const size_t klen = std::min<size_t>(KC, kmain - k0);\n                for (size_t t = 0; t < L.m_tiles; ++t)\n                    kernel(a_tiles.data() + t * L.tile_stride() + k0 * MR, MR, groups, k0, ncols,\n                           klen, S.data() + t * CB * MR, MR, k0 > 0);\n            }\n            if (kmain == 0) std::fill(S.begin(), S.end(), 0.0);\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < L.m_tiles; ++t) {\n                const double* tp = a_tiles.data() + t * L.tile_stride();\n                for (size_t jj = 0; jj < ncols_valid; ++jj) {\n                    double* Sj = S.data() + t * CB * MR + jj * MR;\n                    for (size_t k = kmain; k < n; ++k) {  // fused remainder\n                        const vd bv = vsplat(cur[k * src_pad + c0 + jj]);\n                        for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v)\n                            vstore(Sj + v * VL, vfma(vload(tp + k * MR + v * VL), bv, vload(Sj + v * VL)));\n                    }\n                    const size_t jloc = c0 + jj;\n                    const size_t jglob = ((size_t)src + (jloc / RB) * P) * RB + jloc % RB;\n                    store(t, jglob, Sj);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if (s + 1 < P) {\n            MPI_Waitall(2, reqs, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n            std::swap(cur, nxt);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Matrix generation: A = B * B^T + n * I, B random (same sequence as original)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const Layout& L) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    std::vector<double> Bt(L.m_tiles * L.tile_stride(), 0.0);\n    std::vector<double> Bcols(n * L.m_pad, 0.0);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (every rank walks the full sequence, keeps its rows)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const size_t gb = i / RB;\n        if (L.owner(gb) == L.rank) {\n            const size_t iloc = (gb / L.P) * RB + i % RB;\n            double* tp = Bt.data() + (iloc / MR) * L.tile_stride() + iloc % MR;\n            double* cp = Bcols.data() + iloc;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                const double v = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n                tp[k * MR] = v;\n                cp[k * L.m_pad] = v;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) (void)rand_r(&seed);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T and add diagonal dominance\n    A.assign(L.m_tiles * L.tile_stride(), 0.0);\n    const double nd = (double)n;\n    symmetricProductRing(L, Bt, std::move(Bcols), [&](size_t t, size_t j, const double* s) {\n        double* dst = A.data() + t * L.tile_stride() + j * MR;\n        for (int l = 0; l < MR; ++l) {\n            const size_t iloc = t * MR + l;\n            if (iloc >= L.m_loc) continue;\n            double v = s[l];\n            if (L.global_row(iloc) == j) v += nd;\n            dst[l] = v;\n        }\n    });\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Validation: compare L * L^T with the original matrix\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& Lt, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,\n                      const Layout& L) {\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    symmetricProductRing(L, Lt, tilesToColumns(Lt, L), [&](size_t t, size_t j, const double* s) {\n        const double* ref = A_orig.data() + t * L.tile_stride() + j * MR;\n        for (int l = 0; l < MR; ++l) {\n            if (t * MR + l >= L.m_loc) continue;\n            const double error = fabs(s[l] - ref[l]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(ref[l]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    });\n    double g[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, g, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    maxError = g[0];\n    relError = g[1];\n\n    if (L.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (L.rank == 0) printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed blocked left-looking Cholesky decomposition\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& T, const Layout& L) {\n    const size_t n = L.n, nb = L.nb, nsb = L.nsb, npanels = L.npanels, n_pad = L.n_pad;\n    const int P = L.P, rank = L.rank;\n    const size_t ts = L.tile_stride();\n    const size_t ngroups = nb / NR;\n    const size_t tiles_per_block = RB / MR;\n    const size_t SD_LD = nb + MR;  // row stride of the diagonal partial sums (+ junk columns)\n\n    // Panel buffers (double buffered): panel J holds, for every column j of the\n    // panel, L[j][k] for k < j0 and the stored A values for k in [j0, j0+nb),\n    // packed in column groups of NR; rows of the panel are gathered rank-major.\n    std::vector<double> Pbuf[2] = {std::vector<double>(nb * n_pad + 2 * VL, 0.0),\n                                   std::vector<double>(nb * n_pad + 2 * VL, 0.0)};\n    std::vector<double> zeros(n_pad * NR + 2 * VL, 0.0);  // stands in for missing row blocks\n    std::vector<const double*> groups(ngroups);\n    std::vector<double> S(L.m_tiles * nb * MR);  // partial sums of my trailing rows, per tile\n    std::vector<double> Sd(nb * SD_LD, 0.0);     // partial sums of the diagonal block\n    std::vector<double> Dt(nb * nb, 0.0);        // diagonal block, Dt[kk][ii] = L[ii][kk]\n    std::vector<int> pcounts(P), pdispls(P), scounts(P), sdispls(P);\n\n    // Diagonal block work split: column groups of the panel\n    auto share_begin = [&](int r) { return ((size_t)r * ngroups / P) * NR; };\n    for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n        sdispls[r] = (int)(share_begin(r) * SD_LD);\n        scounts[r] = (int)((share_begin(r + 1) - share_begin(r)) * SD_LD);\n    }\n    const size_t js = share_begin(rank), je = share_begin(rank + 1);\n\n    // Allgather layout of panel J: rank r contributes its row blocks of the panel\n    auto panel_layout = [&](size_t J, size_t& bts) {\n        bts = (J + 1) * nb * NR;  // group stride (krows * NR)\n        const size_t gb0 = J * nsb;\n        const size_t nsb_cur = std::min(nsb, L.nblocks - gb0);\n        int off = 0;\n        for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n            int cnt = 0;\n            for (size_t s = 0; s < nsb_cur; ++s)\n                if (L.owner(gb0 + s) == r) ++cnt;\n            pdispls[r] = off;\n            pcounts[r] = (int)(cnt * GPB * bts);\n            off += pcounts[r];\n        }\n    };\n    auto panel_groups = [&](size_t J, const double* buf, size_t bts) {\n        const size_t gb0 = J * nsb;\n        const size_t nsb_cur = std::min(nsb, L.nblocks - gb0);\n        std::vector<int> idx(P, 0);\n        for (size_t g = 0; g < ngroups; ++g) groups[g] = zeros.data();\n        for (size_t s = 0; s < nsb_cur; ++s) {\n            const int r = L.owner(gb0 + s);\n            for (size_t g = 0; g < GPB; ++g)\n                groups[s * GPB + g] = buf + pdispls[r] + ((size_t)idx[r] * GPB + g) * bts;\n            ++idx[r];\n        }\n    };\n    // Pack my row blocks of panel J (rows k < (J+1)*nb) into my part of buf\n    auto pack_panel = [&](size_t J, double* buf, size_t bts) {\n        const size_t gb0 = J * nsb;\n        const size_t nsb_cur = std::min(nsb, L.nblocks - gb0);\n        const size_t krows = (J + 1) * nb;\n        const size_t kend = std::min(n, krows);\n        double* dst = buf + pdispls[rank];\n        for (size_t s = 0; s < nsb_cur; ++s) {\n            if (L.owner(gb0 + s) != rank) continue;\n            const size_t t0 = ((gb0 + s) / P) * tiles_per_block;\n            for (size_t g = 0; g < GPB; ++g, dst += bts) {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < kend; ++k) {\n                    for (int j = 0; j < NR; ++j) {\n                        const size_t jj = g * NR + j;\n                        dst[k * NR + j] = T[(t0 + jj / MR) * ts + k * MR + jj % MR];\n                    }\n                }\n                std::fill(dst + kend * NR, dst + krows * NR, 0.0);\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    MPI_Request req_panel = MPI_REQUEST_NULL, req_sd = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n    auto progress = [&]() {\n        int flag;\n        if (req_sd != MPI_REQUEST_NULL) MPI_Test(&req_sd, &flag, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        if (req_panel != MPI_REQUEST_NULL) MPI_Test(&req_panel, &flag, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n    };\n\n    // Partial sums over k < j0 for trailing tiles [ta, tb)\n    auto gemm = [&](size_t ta, size_t tb, size_t j0) {\n        for (size_t k0 = 0; k0 < j0; k0 += KC) {\n            const size_t klen = std::min<size_t>(KC, j0 - k0);\n            for (size_t t = ta; t < tb; ++t) {\n                kernel(T.data() + t * ts + k0 * MR, MR, groups.data(), k0, nb, klen, S.data() + t * nb * MR,\n                       MR, k0 > 0);\n                progress();\n            }\n        }\n        if (j0 == 0) std::fill(S.begin() + ta * nb * MR, S.begin() + tb * nb * MR, 0.0);\n    };\n    // Triangular tail of the panel and final division for trailing tiles [ta, tb)\n    auto tail = [&](size_t ta, size_t tb, size_t j0, size_t nb_cur) {\n        for (size_t t = ta; t < tb; ++t) {\n            double* tp = T.data() + t * ts;\n            const double* St = S.data() + t * nb * MR;\n            for (size_t jj = 0; jj < nb_cur; ++jj) {\n                vd s[MV];\n                for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) s[v] = vload(St + jj * MR + v * VL);\n                const size_t kmain = jj - jj % VF;\n                for (size_t kk = 0; kk < kmain; ++kk) {\n                    const vd ljk = vsplat(Dt[kk * nb + jj]);\n                    const double* ap = tp + (j0 + kk) * MR;\n                    for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) s[v] += vload(ap + v * VL) * ljk;\n                }\n                for (size_t kk = kmain; kk < jj; ++kk) {  // fused remainder\n                    const vd ljk = vsplat(Dt[kk * nb + jj]);\n                    const double* ap = tp + (j0 + kk) * MR;\n                    for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) s[v] = vfma(vload(ap + v * VL), ljk, s[v]);\n                }\n                const vd ljj = vsplat(Dt[jj * nb + jj]);\n                double* ap = tp + (j0 + jj) * MR;\n                for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v) vstore(ap + v * VL, (vload(ap + v * VL) - s[v]) / ljj);\n            }\n            progress();\n        }\n    };\n\n    int cur = 0;\n    size_t bts_cur = 0;\n    if (npanels > 0) {\n        panel_layout(0, bts_cur);\n        pack_panel(0, Pbuf[0].data(), bts_cur);\n        MPI_Iallgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, Pbuf[0].data(), pcounts.data(), pdispls.data(),\n                        MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req_panel);\n    }\n\n    for (size_t J = 0; J < npanels; ++J) {\n        const size_t j0 = J * nb;\n        const size_t nb_cur = std::min(nb, n - j0);\n        const double* Pj = Pbuf[cur].data();\n\n        MPI_Wait(&req_panel, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        panel_layout(J, bts_cur);\n        panel_groups(J, Pj, bts_cur);\n\n        // Partial sums of the diagonal block, computed cooperatively (my column groups)\n        if (j0 > 0) {\n            for (size_t gi = 0; gi < ngroups && js < je; ++gi)\n                kernel(groups[gi], NR, groups.data() + js / NR, 0, je - js, j0, Sd.data() + js * SD_LD + gi * NR,\n                       SD_LD, false);\n            MPI_Iallgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, Sd.data(), scounts.data(), sdispls.data(),\n                            MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req_sd);\n        } else {\n            std::fill(Sd.begin(), Sd.end(), 0.0);\n        }\n\n        // Trailing rows: tiles [t_first, m_tiles)\n        const size_t t_first = L.nblk_before((J + 1) * nsb) * tiles_per_block;\n        gemm(t_first, L.m_tiles, j0);\n\n        // Diagonal block: A values from the panel, then factor it (redundantly on\n        // every rank, identical arithmetic)\n        MPI_Wait(&req_sd, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        for (size_t kk = 0; k < n; ++k) {  // fused remainder\n319\t                        const vd bv = vsplat(cur[k * src_pad + c0 + jj]);\n320\t                        for (int v = 0; v < MV; ++v)\n321\t                            vstore(Sj + v * VL, vfma(vload(tp + k * MR + v * VL), bv, vload(Sj + v * VL)));\n322\t                    }\n323\t                    store(t, L.global_row_of(src, c0 + jj), Sj);\n324\t                }\n325\t            }\n326\t        }\n327\t        if (s + 1 < P) {\n328\t            MPI_Waitall(2, reqs, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n329\t            std::swap(cur, nxt);\n330\t        }\n331\t    }\n332\t}\n333\t\n334\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n335\t// Matrix generation: A = B * B^T + n * I, B random (same sequence as original)\n336\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n337\tvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const Layout& L) {\n338\t    const size_t n = L.n;\n339\t    std::vector<double> Bt(L.m_tiles * L.tile_stride(), 0.0);\n340\t    std::vector<double> Bcols(n * L.m_pad, 0.0);\n341\t    unsigned int seed = 42;\n342\t\n343\t    // Generate random matrix B (every rank walks the full sequence, keeps its rows)\n344\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n345\t        const size_t gb = i / RB;\n346\t        if (L.owner(gb) == L.rank) {\n347\t            const size_t iloc = L.lidx_of[gb] * RB + i % RB;\n348\t            double* tp = Bt.data() + (iloc / MR) * L.tile_stride() + iloc % MR;\n349\t            double* cp = Bcols.data() + iloc;\n350\t            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n351\t                const double v = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n352\t                tp[k * MR] = v;\n353\t                cp[k * L.m_pad] = v;\n354\t            }\n355\t        } else {\n356\t            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) (void)rand_r(&seed);\n357\t        }\n358\t    }\n359\t\n360\t    // Compute A = B * B^T and add diagonal dominance\n361\t    A.assign(L.m_tiles * L.tile_stride(), 0.0);\n362\t    const double nd = (double)n;\n363\t    symmetricProductRing(L, Bt, std::move(Bcols), [&](size_t t, size_t j, const double* s) {\n364\t        double* dst = A.data() + t * L.tile_stride() + j * MR;\n365\t        for (int l = 0; l < MR; ++l) {\n366\t            const size_t iloc = t * MR + l;\n367\t            if (iloc >= L.m_loc) continue;\n368\t            double v = s[l];\n369\t            if (L.global_row(iloc) == j) v += nd;\n370\t            dst[l] = v;\n371\t        }\n372\t    });\n373\t}\n374\t\n375\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n376\t// Validation: compare L * L^T with the original matrix\n377\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n378\tbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& Lt, const std::vector<double>& A_orig,\n379\t                      const Layout& L) {\n380\t    double maxError = 0.0;\n381\t    double relError = 0.0;\n382\t    symmetricProductRing(L, Lt, tilesToColumns(Lt, L), [&](size_t t, size_t j, const double* s) {\n383\t        const double* ref = A_orig.data() + t * L.tile_stride() + j * MR;\n384\t        for (int l = 0; l < MR; ++l) {\n385\t            if (t * MR + l >= L.m_loc) continue;\n386\t            const double error = fabs(s[l] - ref[l]);\n387\t            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n388\t            const double rel = error / (fabs(ref[l]) + 1e-10);\n389\t            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n390\t        }\n391\t    });\n392\t    double g[2] = {maxError, relError};\n393\t    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, g, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n394\t    maxError = g[0];\n395\t    relError = g[1];\n396\t\n397\t    if (L.rank == 0) {\n398\t        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n399\t        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n400\t    }\n401\t\n402\t    // Check if error is within tolerance\n403\t    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n404\t        if (L.rank == 0) printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n405\t        return false;\n406\t    }\n407\t    return true;\n408\t}\n409\t\n410\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n411\t// Node topology and shared memory. Ranks on the same node share the panel\n412\t// buffers through an MPI-3 shared memory window (data is written once by the\n413\t// owner and read in place by everybody on the node); between nodes the data is\n414\t// forwarded by pipelined binomial-tree broadcasts built from point-to-point\n415\t// messages, which are progressed from the compute loops.\n416\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n417\t// A \"node\" here is a group of ranks that share memory: the ranks of one\n418\t// socket when the MPI library can tell (keeps the shared panel in socket-local\n419\t// memory), otherwise the ranks of the whole node.\n420\tstruct Node {\n421\t    MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_NULL;  // ranks of my node\n422\t    int size = 1, rank = 0;         // within the node\n423\t    int nnodes = 1, my_node = 0;\n424\t    std::vector<int> node_of;                 // world rank -> node index\n425\t    std::vector<int> leader_of;               // node index -> world rank of its first rank\n426\t    std::vector<std::vector<int>> members_of;  // node index -> world ranks (in node rank order)\n427\t};\n428\t\n429\tNode makeNode(int P, int rank) {\n430\t    Node N;\n431\t#ifdef OMPI_COMM_TYPE_SOCKET\n432\t    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, OMPI_COMM_TYPE_SOCKET, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &N.comm);\n433\t#else\n434\t    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &N.comm);\n435\t#endif\n436\t    MPI_Comm_size(N.comm, &N.size);\n437\t    MPI_Comm_rank(N.comm, &N.rank);\n438\t    int leader = rank;\n439\t    MPI_Bcast(&leader, 1, MPI_INT, 0, N.comm);\n440\t    std::vector<int> leaders(P);\n441\t    MPI_Allgather(&leader, 1, MPI_INT, leaders.data(), 1, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n442\t    N.leader_of = leaders;\n443\t    std::sort(N.leader_of.begin(), N.leader_of.end());\n444\t    N.leader_of.erase(std::unique(N.leader_of.begin(), N.leader_of.end()), N.leader_of.end());\n445\t    N.nnodes = (int)N.leader_of.size();\n446\t    N.node_of.resize(P);\n447\t    N.members_of.assign(N.nnodes, {});\n448\t    for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n449\t        N.node_of[r] = (int)(std::lower_bound(N.leader_of.begin(), N.leader_of.end(), leaders[r]) - N.leader_of.begin());\n450\t        N.members_of[N.node_of[r]].push_back(r);  // world rank order == node rank order (split key = rank)\n451\t    }\n452\t    N.my_node = N.node_of[rank];\n453\t    return N;\n454\t}\n455\t\n456\tinline void flag_set(volatile uint64_t* f, uint64_t v) { __atomic_store_n(f, v, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }\n457\tinline uint64_t flag_get(volatile uint64_t* f) { return __atomic_load_n(f, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }\n458\tinline void flag_add(volatile uint64_t* f, uint64_t v) { __atomic_add_fetch(f, v, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL); }\n459\t\n460\t// Inter-node broadcasts into node-shared memory. The participants are one rank\n461\t// per node: the owner on its node, elsewhere a member of the node chosen per\n462\t// object (spreads the receive work over the node's ranks). Two kinds:\n463\t//  * direct: the buffer has the same meaning on every node; the owner's data\n464\t//    is already in place, remote leaders receive into it and set the flag.\n465\t//  * staged: the owner sends from src (contiguous), the receiving rank stores\n466\t//    it in a staging buffer, sets the stage flag, then post-processes it\n467\t//    (scatter into the panel) and sets the flag.\n468\tclass BcastPool {\n469\t  public:\n470\t    using Post = void (*)(void*, int);\n471\t    BcastPool(const Node& N, int rank, int nobj, Post post, void* ctx)\n472\t        : N_(N), rank_(rank), objs_(nobj), post_(post), ctx_(post ? ctx : nullptr) {}\n473\t\n474\t    // Start object o: count doubles; the owner sends from src, remote nodes\n475\t    // receive into dst (same address meaning on every node). stage == nullptr\n476\t    // means direct. Tags [tag, tag + MAXSEG) are used.\n477\t    void start(int o, const double* src, double* dst, size_t count, int owner, int tag, volatile uint64_t* stage,\n478\t               volatile uint64_t* flag, uint64_t flag_val) {\n479\t        Obj& ob = objs_[o];\n480\t        ob.src = src;\n481\t        ob.dst = dst;\n482\t        ob.count = count;\n483\t        ob.root_node = N_.node_of[owner];\n484\t        ob.owner = owner;\n485\t        ob.tag = tag;\n486\t        ob.stage = stage;\n487\t        ob.flag = flag;\n488\t        ob.flag_val = flag_val;\n489\t        ob.seg = std::max<size_t>(MINSEG, (count + MAXSEG - 1) / MAXSEG);\n490\t        ob.nseg = count == 0 ? 0 : (count + ob.seg - 1) / ob.seg;\n491\t        ob.recv_pending = ob.send_pending = 0;\n492\t        if (N_.my_node == ob.root_node) {\n493\t            if (rank_ == owner) {\n494\t                flag_set(flag, flag_val);  // data was written by the owner before start()\n495\t                for (size_t g = 0; g < ob.nseg; ++g) sendSegment(o, g);\n496\t            }\n497\t        } else if (rank_ == rep(o, (N_.my_node - ob.root_node + N_.nnodes) % N_.nnodes)) {\n498\t            const int rel = (N_.my_node - ob.root_node + N_.nnodes) % N_.nnodes;\n499\t            const int parent = rep(o, (rel & (rel - 1)));  // clear lowest set bit\n500\t            for (size_t g = 0; g < ob.nseg; ++g) {\n501\t                items_.push_back({MPI_REQUEST_NULL, o, (int)g});\n502\t                MPI_Irecv(ob.dst + g * ob.seg, segLen(ob, g), MPI_DOUBLE, parent, tag + (int)g, MPI_COMM_WORLD,\n503\t                          &items_.back().req);\n504\t                ++ob.recv_pending;\n505\t            }\n506\t            if (stage != nullptr) posts_.push_back(o);\n507\t            if (ob.nseg == 0) arrived(o);\n508\t        }\n509\t    }\n510\t    // Wait until the data of object o is available on this node (flag set).\n511\t    void wait(int o) {\n512\t        const Obj& ob = objs_[o];\n513\t        while (flag_get(ob.flag) < ob.flag_val) progress(true);\n514\t    }\n515\t    // Wait for all outstanding sends of this rank (buffers may be reused afterwards).\n516\t    void drain() {\n517\t        while (!sends_.empty()) progress(true);\n518\t    }\n519\t    // Test outstanding receives (every poll) and sends (occasionally); forward\n520\t    // received segments to the child nodes; post-process staged objects.\n521\t    // Throttled unless forced.\n522\t    void progress(bool force = false) {\n523\t        if (items_.empty() && sends_.empty() && posts_.empty()) return;\n524\t        const double now = MPI_Wtime();\n525\t        if (!force && now - last_ < 15e-6) return;\n526\t        last_ = now;\n527\t        if (!items_.empty()) {\n528\t            reqs_.resize(items_.size());\n529\t            for (size_t i = 0; i < items_.size(); ++i) reqs_[i] = items_[i].req;\n530\t            idx_.resize(items_.size());\n531\t            int outcount = 0;\n532\t            MPI_Testsome((int)reqs_.size(), reqs_.data(), &outcount, idx_.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n533\t            if (outcount > 0) {\n534\t                std::sort(idx_.begin(), idx_.begin() + outcount);\n535\t                forward_.clear();\n536\t                for (int c = outcount - 1; c >= 0; --c) {  // remove completed items (descending)\n537\t                    forward_.push_back(items_[idx_[c]]);\n538\t                    items_[idx_[c]] = items_.back();\n539\t                    items_.pop_back();\n540\t                }\n541\t                for (const Item& it : forward_) {\n542\t                    sendSegment(it.obj, it.seg);\n543\t                    if (--objs_[it.obj].recv_pending == 0) arrived(it.obj);\n544\t                }\n545\t            }\n546\t        }\n547\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < posts_.size();) {\n548\t            const Obj& ob = objs_[posts_[i]];\n549\t            if (flag_get(ob.stage) >= ob.flag_val) {\n550\t                post_(ctx_, posts_[i]);\n551\t                flag_set(ob.flag, ob.flag_val);\n552\t                posts_[i] = posts_.back();\n553\t                posts_.pop_back();\n554\t            } else {\n555\t                ++i;\n556\t            }\n557\t        }\n558\t        if (!sends_.empty() && (force || ++spoll_ % 8 == 0)) {\n559\t            reqs_.resize(sends_.size());\n560\t            for (size_t i = 0; i < sends_.size(); ++i) reqs_[i] = sends_[i].req;\n561\t            idx_.resize(sends_.size());\n562\t            int outcount = 0;\n563\t            MPI_Testsome((int)reqs_.size(), reqs_.data(), &outcount, idx_.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n564\t            if (outcount > 0) {\n565\t                std::sort(idx_.begin(), idx_.begin() + outcount);\n566\t                for (int c = outcount - 1; c >= 0; --c) {\n567\t                    --objs_[sends_[idx_[c]].obj].send_pending;\n568\t                    sends_[idx_[c]] = sends_.back();\n569\t                    sends_.pop_back();\n570\t                }\n571\t            }\n572\t        }\n573\t    }\n574\t\n575\t  private:\n576\t    struct Obj {\n577\t        const double* src = nullptr;\n578\t        double* dst = nullptr;\n579\t        size_t count = 0, seg = 0, nseg = 0;\n580\t        int root_node = 0, owner = 0, tag = 0, recv_pending = 0, send_pending = 0;\n581\t        volatile uint64_t* stage = nullptr;\n582\t        volatile uint64_t* flag = nullptr;\n583\t        uint64_t flag_val = 0;\n584\t    };\n585\t    struct Item {\n586\t        MPI_Request req;\n587\t        int obj, seg;\n588\t    };\n589\t    static constexpr size_t MINSEG = 49152;  // doubles per segment (384 KB)\n590\t    static constexpr size_t MAXSEG = 8;      // max segments per object\n591\t\n592\t    // data of object o has fully arrived on this (non-root) node\n593\t    void arrived(int o) {\n594\t        const Obj& ob = objs_[o];\n595\t        flag_set(ob.stage != nullptr ? ob.stage : ob.flag, ob.flag_val);\n596\t    }\n597\t    // participating rank for object o of the node with relative index rel\n598\t    int rep(int o, int rel) const {\n599\t        const Obj& ob = objs_[o];\n600\t        const int node = (rel + ob.root_node) % N_.nnodes;\n601\t        if (node == ob.root_node) return ob.owner;\n602\t        const std::vector<int>& m = N_.members_of[node];\n603\t        return m[(size_t)o % m.size()];\n604\t    }\n605\t    int segLen(const Obj& ob, size_t g) const { return (int)std::min(ob.seg, ob.count - g * ob.seg); }\n606\t    void sendSegment(int o, size_t g) {\n607\t        Obj& ob = objs_[o];\n608\t        const double* from = (rank_ == ob.owner) ? ob.src : ob.dst;\n609\t        const int rel = (N_.my_node - ob.root_node + N_.nnodes) % N_.nnodes;\n610\t        const int lowbit = rel == 0 ? N_.nnodes : (rel & -rel);\n611\t        for (int b = 1; b < lowbit && rel + b < N_.nnodes; b <<= 1) {\n612\t            sends_.push_back({MPI_REQUEST_NULL, o, (int)g});\n613\t            MPI_Isend(from + g * ob.seg, segLen(ob, g), MPI_DOUBLE, rep(o, rel + b), ob.tag + (int)g, MPI_COMM_WORLD,\n614\t                      &sends_.back().req);\n615\t            ++ob.send_pending;\n616\t        }\n617\t    }\n618\t\n619\t    const Node& N_;\n620\t    int rank_;\n621\t    std::vector<Obj> objs_;\n622\t    Post post_;\n623\t    void* ctx_;\n624\t    std::vector<Item> items_;    // outstanding receives\n625\t    std::vector<Item> sends_;    // outstanding sends\n626\t    std::vector<Item> forward_;  // scratch\n627\t    std::vector<int> posts_;     // staged objects I post-process\n628\t    std::vector<MPI_Request> reqs_;\n629\t    std::vector<int> idx_;\n630\t    double last_ = 0.0;\n631\t    unsigned spoll_ = 0;\n632\t};\n633\t\n634\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n635\t// Distributed blocked left-looking Cholesky decomposition\n636\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n637\tbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& T, const Layout& L, const Node& N) {\n638\t    const size_t n = L.n, nb = L.nb, nsb = L.nsb, npanels = L.npanels, n_pad = L.n_pad;\n639\t    const int rank = L.rank;\n640\t    const size_t ts = L.tile_stride();\n641\t    const size_t ngroups = nb / NR;\n642\t    const size_t sub_tile = RB * nb;  // doubles of S per row block (one tile)\n643\t    constexpr size_t NBUF = 3;        // panel buffers in flight\n644\t\n645\t    // Node-shared memory: NBUF panel buffers, NBUF diagonal-sum buffers, flags.\n646\t    // Panel J (in buffer J % NBUF) holds, for every column j of the panel,\n647\t    // L[j][k] for k < j0 and the stored A values for k in [j0, j0+nb), packed\n648\t    // in column groups of NR: group g is at buf + g * bts, element (k, j) at\n649\t    // [k*NR + j]. The owner of each RB-row block of the panel scatters its\n650\t    // columns into the groups.\n651\t    const size_t panel_sz = nb * n_pad + 2 * VL;\n652\t    const size_t sdt_sz = nsb * sub_tile;\n653\t    const size_t stage_sz = N.nnodes > 1 ? nb * n_pad : 0;  // staging for panel blocks from other nodes\n654\t    const size_t data_doubles = NBUF * (panel_sz + sdt_sz + stage_sz);\n655\t    const size_t nflags = NBUF * (3 * nsb + 1);\n656\t    MPI_Win win;\n657\t    double* base = nullptr;\n658\t    {\n659\t        const MPI_Aint bytes = N.rank == 0 ? (MPI_Aint)(data_doubles * sizeof(double) + nflags * sizeof(uint64_t)) : 0;\n660\t        MPI_Win_allocate_shared(bytes, sizeof(double), MPI_INFO_NULL, N.comm, &base, &win);\n661\t        MPI_Aint qsize;\n662\t        int qdisp;\n663\t        MPI_Win_shared_query(win, 0, &qsize, &qdisp, &base);\n664\t        if (N.rank == 0) memset(base, 0, (size_t)bytes);\n665\t        MPI_Barrier(N.comm);\n666\t    }\n667\t    double* panel[NBUF];\n668\t    double* sdt[NBUF];\n669\t    double* stage[NBUF];\n670\t    for (size_t b = 0; b < NBUF; ++b) {\n671\t        panel[b] = base + b * panel_sz;\n672\t        sdt[b] = base + NBUF * panel_sz + b * sdt_sz;\n673\t        stage[b] = base + NBUF * (panel_sz + sdt_sz) + b * stage_sz;\n674\t    }\n675\t    volatile uint64_t* flags = reinterpret_cast<volatile uint64_t*>(base + data_doubles);\n676\t    auto pflag = [&](size_t J, size_t s) { return flags + (J % NBUF) * nsb + s; };                   // panel block ready\n677\t    auto sflag = [&](size_t J, size_t s) { return flags + NBUF * nsb + (J % NBUF) * nsb + s; };      // diag sums ready\n678\t    auto gflag = [&](size_t J, size_t s) { return flags + 2 * NBUF * nsb + (J % NBUF) * nsb + s; };  // staged block arrived\n679\t    auto dflag = [&](size_t J) { return flags + 3 * NBUF * nsb + J % NBUF; };                         // steps finished\n680\t\n681\t    std::vector<const double*> groups(ngroups);\n682\t    std::vector<double> S(L.m_tiles * nb * MR);  // partial sums of my trailing rows, per tile\n683\t    std::vector<double> Sd(nb * nb, 0.0);        // Sd[jj][ii]\n684\t    std::vector<double> Dt(nb * nb, 0.0);        // diagonal block, Dt[kk][ii] = L[ii][kk]\n685\t\n686\t    // Scatter a row block (tile layout [k][RB], kend rows) of panel J into the column groups\n687\t    auto scatter_block = [&](const double* tp, size_t J, size_t s) {\n688\t        const size_t bts = (J + 1) * nb * NR;\n689\t        const size_t krows = (J + 1) * nb;\n690\t        const size_t kend = std::min(n, krows);\n691\t        double* dst[RB];\n692\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < RB; ++j) {\n693\t            const size_t jj = s * RB + j;\n694\t            dst[j] = panel[J % NBUF] + (jj / NR) * bts + jj % NR;\n695\t        }\n696\t        for (size_t k = 0; k < kend; ++k)\n697\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < RB; ++j) dst[j][k * NR] = tp[k * RB + j];\n698\t        for (size_t k = kend; k < krows; ++k)\n699\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < RB; ++j) dst[j][k * NR] = 0.0;\n700\t    };\n701\t    // Broadcast objects: [0, nsb) panel row blocks (staged), [nsb, 2 nsb)\n702\t    // diagonal partial sums (direct). Post-processing of a staged block on\n703\t    // another node: scatter it from the staging area into the panel.\n704\t    struct PostCtx {\n705\t        decltype(scatter_block)* scatter;\n706\t        double** stage;\n707\t        size_t nsb, n_pad, J;\n708\t    } post_ctx{&scatter_block, stage, nsb, n_pad, 0};\n709\t    auto post_fn = [](void* c, int o) {\n710\t        PostCtx* pc = static_cast<PostCtx*>(c);\n711\t        const size_t s = (size_t)o;\n712\t        (*pc->scatter)(pc->stage[pc->J % NBUF] + s * RB * pc->n_pad, pc->J, s);\n713\t    };\n714\t    BcastPool bc(N, rank, (int)(2 * nsb), post_fn, &post_ctx);\n715\t    auto progress = [&]() { bc.progress(); Distributed-memory Cholesky decomposition (MPI).\n//\n// Decomposes a positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular.\n//\n// Parallelization scheme\n// ----------------------\n// * Rows of the matrix are distributed over the MPI ranks in blocks of RB rows\n//   (reflected block-cyclic: block b costs ~b^2, blocks are dealt from the\n//   heaviest down to the least loaded rank). Every rank stores only its own\n//   rows, in a SIMD friendly \"row tile\" layout: groups of MR consecutive local\n//   rows are stored k-major (tile[k][0..MR)), so that for a fixed column k the\n//   MR row entries are contiguous.\n// * The factorization is a blocked left-looking algorithm over column panels of\n//   NB columns (NB is a multiple of RB, so a panel consists of several row\n//   blocks that may live on different ranks).
